_about: W-analysis store: one record per 2004 federal polling place keyed to the four SEIFA 2001 indexes (irsd/irsad/ier/ieo scores + national deciles) via the CD (ASGC 2001, GDA94) polygon containing the booth's premises coordinates. The area is the area OF THE PREMISES — a geographic proxy for the catchment's SES, not an aggregate of catchment voters; compare across census vintages by decile only. The 2004 AEC file ships no coordinate columns: coordinates were carried from the 2007 file (keyed state+division+place name, then premises+suburb) and flagged coordsFrom=2007. SEIFA 2001 publishes no per-area deciles; the store's national deciles are derived by ABS's own 2001 quantile recipe (each area counted once, never population-weighted), verified against every published state quantile cell in the cube and the release's prose medians. Each scored booth also carries seifa.pct (its area's score percentile inside the measured census's cube) and seifaInterp, an interpolated percentile between this election's two bracketing censuses (day-shared; method and factors in _pcti) — the comparable-across-vintages field. Coordinate-less mobile/hospital teams carry note=noCoords; cube-suppressed areas carry note=seifaSuppressed with seifa:null. stateFlag is a guard report only; the physical premises location wins.

coordCarryForward.note: 2004 csv has no coord columns; keys (state,div,place) then (state,div,premises,suburb) onto 2007 rows with non-(0,0) coords

_pcti.method: seifa.pct = the prePrefs area's score percentile among all scored areas of the measured cube (ascending score, min-rank on ties, most-disadvantaged low; r6 half-up). seifaInterp keys a second point-in-polygon join of the same premises coords against the OTHER bracketing census-era geometry; pcti = (1-f)*pct0 + f*pct1 computed from the emitted r6-rounded pct0/pct1/f (the file re-derives its own pcti). Rank percentiles interpolate absolute SES position across re-based editions; raw scores never do. Booths whose far-side point lands outside any polygon (interpFarOutside) or in a score-suppressed area (interpFarSuppressed) carry pct only.
